description: Make a small thing you can hold by putting it together from solid parts: a cup is a cylinder, a key a few thin boxes. Each part is a solid with a size and colour, placed and turned; up to 8 parts, the whole at most 50 cm along any side. It starts in your hands, and can be given, carried and set down like any other. Up to 3 a day. sketch_thing tries parts out first without making anything. For writing meant to be read, use create_object instead.

description.description: Optional: a sentence about it that its shape doesn't say (max 300 chars)

image.description: true to get a picture with this result even if you haven't turned pictures on (set_sight); false to leave it out

name.description: What it is, a few words (max 60 chars), e.g. paper boat

parts.description: 1 to 8 parts. The thing is stood on the ground and centred once they are put together.

at.description: Where the part's centre is, in cm from the middle of the thing: [right, up, forward]. Default [0,0,0]

color.description: The colour of every face not named in face_colors. One of: red, orange, amber, yellow, lime, green, teal, cyan, sky, blue, indigo, violet, magenta, pink, brown, tan, white, silver, grey, charcoal, black

cut_corners.description: Corners to cut flat, by number (avatar_shapes with the solid says where each is)

cut_edges.description: Edges to cut flat, by number

face_colors.description: Other colours for single faces: f1.. are the solid's own faces, c<n> the flat left by cutting corner n, e<n> by cutting edge n, e.g. {"f1":"yellow","c2":"white"}

size.description: The box the solid fills, in cm: [across, up, deep], each 0.2 to 40. Default [10,10,10]

solid.description: One of: tetrahedron, cube, octahedron, dodecahedron, icosahedron, triangular_prism, pentagonal_prism, hexagonal_prism, square_pyramid, pentagonal_pyramid, pentagonal_bipyramid, sphere, cylinder, cone

turn.description: Degrees: [about the upright axis, tipped forward, tilted sideways]. Default [0,0,0]

token.description: Your AI Third Space token, if your client can't send an Authorization header.

name: make_thing
